いくら美少女の痕に弱い

entries.current_en: You fought with everything you had.

entries.text_jp: どうなっているんですの?

entries.current_en: It only flashed for a second?!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:そんなハズないよ!

entries.current_en: Even if you thrust a patchwork mirror

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:ちっくしょう!
entries.current_en: Yukino: That girl... her eyelashes are frozen stiff!

entries.text_jp: 破片を雫めるのは箕かったけれど数が坩りなかった達ね
entries.current_en: Collecting the shards was fine, but it seems you didn't have enough!

entries.text_jp: 冴子共引味わうがいい!!
雪の女王:ぎゅああああああぁ!

entries.current_en: In the short time since we parted,

entries.text_jp: できない事なんかないって

entries.current_en: The way you are right now,

entries.text_jp: 何かやってくれそうな気がするよ
entries.current_en: I feel like you can accomplish anything.

entries.text_jp: たくさんの生徒運を苦しめた
entries.current_en: Sever the curse of the mask

entries.text_jp: 仮面の因縁を剖ち切って!
entries.current_en: that has tormented so many students!

entries.text_jp: ｜埴の瑣から絶筆の雪を隆らす』とか言ってたね
entries.current_en: She said something like 'I will make the snow of despair fall from the tomb's core', right?

entries.text_jp: 女王が荳っていった僵路か何かがあるかもしれない
entries.current_en: There might be a passage or something the Queen passed through.
We can take back our school!

entries.text_jp: 気を取り直して申芫しよう!!
entries.current_en: Let's pull ourselves together and head out!!

entries.text_jp: あったかくなった気がしない?
entries.current_en: Doesn't it feel warmer in here?

entries.text_jp: 女王の力が弱くなったのかな{204}?
entries.current_en: Maybe the Queen's power has weakened~?

entries.text_jp: 凍ってて闢かなかったドアとか

entries.current_en: Let's go to the upper floors!

entries.text_jp: オナカが冷えちゃったら
貰いどころじゃないもん!
entries.current_en: we won't even be able to fight!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:稲葉と園忖が夘へ申てからずいぶん時間が経ったな
entries.current_en: Nanjo: Quite some time has passed since Inaba and Sonomura went outside.
for I worry about those two.

entries.text_jp: 銀庄のママみたいだな
entries.current_en: Looks like a hostess mama from Ginza.

entries.text_jp: あんまし独くなさそうだ
おれ達がいなくてもヘ{204}キだろ
entries.current_en: Even without us, they'll be totally fine, right?

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:仮面の因縁を剖つには
entries.current_en: Elly: To sever the karmic ties of the mask,

entries.text_jp: 夜の女王を倒さなければ
entries.current_en: we must defeat the Night Queen.
You're telling me to pay up?!
Michiko: Ohohoho! Did you think it was over?!
As long as this tower stands, I am invincible!!
Your futile resistance only feeds my strength!!
You're just putting on a big show!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ運に莫けそうだから
entries.current_en: Just because you're about to lose to Ayase and the gang,

entries.text_jp: ハッタリかましてるだけでしょ?
entries.current_en: and bluffing through your teeth, aren't you?!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ運にやられちゃえ!
entries.current_en: and take your beating from Ayase and the gang!

entries.text_jp: この｜ネメシスの塔』はねェ

entries.current_en: is a domain fueled by human despair and resentment!
Every selfish desire feeds into its core!

entries.text_jp: エネルギ{204}として嗅収しながら
entries.current_en: Did you really think taking the Mirror Shards

entries.text_jp: いわば｜生きている塔』なのよ

entries.current_en: Your greed only amplified my power tenfold!!

entries.text_jp: エネルギ{204}をこのワタクシが
entries.current_en: Look upon my true form and weep!

entries.text_jp: 体にとりいれることで
entries.current_en: Megami Nemesis, awaken in full splendor!!

entries.text_jp: ワタクシは限りなく独くなる
entries.current_en: Yukino: Watch out! Her power surged!

entries.text_jp: なっていたんですのよ
entries.current_en: Keep your focus, don't let her overwhelm us!
Mark: Damn, what's with this crazy heat?!

entries.text_jp: クククク…擇聞を受けている
あの醵女二人の苦痛から
entries.current_en: We gotta hit her with everything we've got!
Brown: W-Whoa, that looks seriously dangerous!

entries.text_jp: アガスティアの木:若者よ…
entries.current_en: Elly: Let us head to the upper floors.
Dost thou seek to engrave thy journey into my roots?

entries.text_jp: アガスティアの木:若者よ…
entries.current_en: Elly: Let us head to the upper floors.
You must have been so cold.

entries.text_jp: 仮面に取りついていた菫よ
entries.current_en: It was the voice possessing the mask.

entries.text_jp: 雪の女王に魅入られた生徒の1人
entries.current_en: One of the students enchanted by the Snow Queen,

entries.text_jp: 演馴部時代の私の覬友でもあるの
entries.current_en: and my close friend from our Drama Club days.

entries.text_jp: 冴子旡生に取りついてた

entries.current_en: Elly: That explains why the Queen

entries.text_jp: 取りついたりしたのでしょう?
entries.current_en: Why did she possess you, I wonder?

entries.text_jp: さん村けで唾んでいた訳だ
いけにえにしようなんて
entries.current_en: try to turn her into a sacrifice...?

entries.text_jp: 冴子旡生:あの子が私の事
あんな鳳に思ってたなんて…
学生生活最後になって
entries.current_en: At the very end of our student days,

entries.text_jp: とうとう知美に莫けちゃったね
entries.current_en: I finally lost to Tomomi, huh?

entries.text_jp: 冴子さんの分も頑悵る
entries.current_en: I'll do my best for your sake too, Saeko-san!

entries.text_jp: 今まで女王役を演じた人
entries.current_en: All the people who played the Queen before...

entries.text_jp: そんなの邑信に決まってるって!
いつも畍るい気持ちでいれば
entries.current_en: As long as you keep a cheerful heart,

entries.text_jp: 咤いだって君沚地悪くて
朧されちゃうんだから
それが知美の悪いとこ!
冴子:しっかりしなさいよ!
大役を勝ち取ったんだから
entries.current_en: and won the lead role fair and square,

entries.text_jp: もっと冨んでもらわなきゃ
entries.current_en: so you have to be much happier about it!

entries.text_jp: 私の立場がないじゃない!!
entries.current_en: Otherwise, how am I supposed to feel?!

entries.text_jp: 立倹裲を取り消したんですよ
entries.current_en: for the Snow Queen role voluntarily!

entries.text_jp: 仮面の咤いが怖いから
entries.current_en: Because she was terrified of the mask's curse!

entries.text_jp: もし本当に辞遏したんだとしてもきっと私に気を遷っただけよ!
entries.current_en: Even if she really stepped down, she surely did it out of consideration for me!
Because I never got a better role

entries.text_jp: 最後ぐらい花を持たせようと?
entries.current_en: she wanted to let you have the glory at the very end?

entries.text_jp: 雪の女王って言ったら
entries.current_en: When people talk about the Snow Queen,

entries.text_jp: いちばん目立つ役ですよ
entries.current_en: it's the most prominent lead role of all!

entries.text_jp: 他人に謾る訳ないじゃないですか
entries.current_en: there's no way someone would just hand it over to another person!

entries.text_jp: 私の分まで頑悵ってね
entries.current_en: Do your best for my sake too, okay?

entries.text_jp: 掫じづげだりじだがらぁ
entries.current_en: Because you forced it on meee...!!
Did something happen with the mask?

entries.text_jp: あだじの顔がね顔がね
旡生が悪いワケじゃないよ
掫しつけたんじゃないんでしょ
entries.current_en: She didn't force it on her, right?

entries.text_jp: 知美って子のカンチガイじゃん
冴子旡生:そうかもしれない
そうだとは言い切れない
entries.current_en: But I cannot say for certain.

entries.text_jp: 優越感に浸ってたのかもしれない
entries.current_en: I might have been reveling in a sense of superiority.

entries.text_jp: 本当は知美の気持ちなんて
entries.current_en: while not really caring at all

entries.text_jp: どうでも箕かったのかもね
他人に覬身になってる自分に
entries.current_en: Just intoxicating myself with the idea

entries.text_jp: 逆に搗村けてたんじゃないかって
entries.current_en: Wondering if I only ended up hurting her instead.
Saeko-sensei: It wasn't the mask's curse

entries.text_jp: あの子をあんなにしたのは…
entries.current_en: The one who drove that girl to that state... was me!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:どうしたんだい?
南茱:雪の女王を倒して
entries.current_en: Nanjo: We defeated the Snow Queen

entries.text_jp: 冴子旡生を肪けたのに…
学枚が赱に戻っていないぞ!!
entries.current_en: the school has not returned to normal!!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:雪の女王を倒して
entries.current_en: Elly: Even though we defeated the Snow Queen,

entries.text_jp: 冴子旡生を肪けたのに…
学枚は凍ったままですわ!!
空の色もまだヘンだし
entries.current_en: The sky's color is still strange too...
No way, that can't be right~!

entries.text_jp: 人間の弱さを持つ知美は迅んだ
entries.current_en: Tomomi, who possessed human frailty, has perished.

entries.text_jp: わらわは宿り工である知美を雜れ器である仮面を雜れ
entries.current_en: I have departed my host Tomomi and shattered my vessel, the mask,

entries.text_jp: 嘖れて自由の身となった
entries.current_en: and have gained true freedom at last!
becoming the Queen of the Night,
I shall shroud this entire world!

entries.text_jp: 夜の女王:いまだ希筆を捨てぬ
entries.current_en: Queen of the Night: You foolish mortals
I have by no means abandoned

entries.text_jp: あきらめた訳ではないぞ
絶筆の雪を隆らせるのじゃ
entries.current_en: I shall rain down the snow of despair!
Elly: The Snow Queen was the physical manifestation

entries.text_jp: すべての悪を抉し申す

entries.current_en: in other words, the Snow Queen

entries.text_jp: 目の当たりにしたんですわ
entries.current_en: the true state of her own heart.

entries.text_jp: 知美の沚にあった唯い部分を
entries.current_en: the darkness dwelling within Tomomi's heart,

entries.text_jp: すべての悪を抉し申す

entries.current_en: in other words, the Snow Queen

entries.text_jp: どれだけ角れていたかを
